reviews.title: Best Alarm App
reviews.text: Waykee is easily the best alarm app out there in the app store! The setup process was very simple, personalized and relatable! I love the modern and sleek UI. And the missions system being used to wake me up works wonderfully! Premium is also very cheap and worth it! 10/10 props to the small dev team who put their hearts in to make this! ❤️
